name: Lateral Step-Up
steps: Stand sideways beside a sturdy box and place your closer foot firmly flat on top of the platform.
Lean your torso slightly over your elevated foot while bracing your core and keeping your hips square.
Drive powerfully through your elevated foot to stand tall on top of the box without bouncing off your trailing foot.
Lower your trailing foot slowly back to the floor under control, and switch sides after completing one leg.
tips: Keep your working knee aligned cleanly over your toes instead of letting it cave inward.
Control the descent slowly rather than dropping down onto your bottom foot.
